about.title: A small practice, on purpose
paragraphs: Lumen opened in 2011 with a simple idea: most people don't dislike the dentist, they dislike feeling rushed. So we built the practice around time — longer appointments, one clinician who knows your history, and a treatment plan explained in plain language before you agree to anything.
Our five-surgery studio in Dubai Marina brings preventive care, implants, orthodontics and cosmetic dentistry under one roof, which means complex cases stay with a team that already knows you.

faqs.title: Questions we're asked every week
faqs.description: If yours isn't here, message us on WhatsApp — a clinician answers, not a chatbot.

items.question: Do you accept insurance?
items.answer: We work with most major UAE insurers including AXA, Daman, Cigna, Bupa Global and Allianz. Send us a photo of your card before your visit and we'll confirm your coverage and any co-payment in writing beforehand.

items.question: How quickly can I be seen?
items.answer: Routine appointments are usually available within the same week. We hold emergency slots open every weekday for pain, swelling or trauma — call before 10am and we'll almost always see you that day.

items.question: I'm genuinely afraid of the dentist. What can you do?
items.answer: Tell us when you book and we'll flag it on your file. We'll allocate extra time, start with a conversation rather than an examination, and agree a stop signal before anything begins. Oral sedation and IV sedation are both available with our visiting anaesthetist.

items.question: Will I know the cost before treatment starts?
items.answer: Always. After your examination you receive a written plan itemising every step, the cost, and what your insurance is expected to cover. Nothing begins until you have signed it, and the figure does not change unless the clinical picture does — in which case we stop and speak with you first.

items.question: Do you treat children?
items.answer: Yes, from around age three. First visits are deliberately short and involve no treatment — a ride in the chair, a look with the mirror, and a sticker. Preventive care, sealants and orthodontic monitoring follow from there.

items.question: Is parking available?
items.answer: Yes. Complimentary underground parking is available in the building, and we validate your ticket at reception. The clinic is a four-minute walk from DMCC Metro Station.

items.question: What happens if something goes wrong with my treatment?
items.answer: Implants, crowns, bridges and veneers carry a written warranty which you keep. If a restoration fails within that period through no fault of usage, we replace it at no charge. Call us and we will see you as a priority.
